title: Guide to moving house and changing your details with NSW Government agencies
summary: This guide explains how to update your address and personal details across various NSW government services, including licences, registrations, and records.
who_can_apply: Any citizen or resident who needs to update their address or personal details with NSW Government agencies.
what_you_need: Your existing licence, registration, or card details.
Proof of your new address (if required by the specific service).
Relevant account login details for online services.

faqs.q: What types of records can I update my address for?
faqs.a: You can update your address for services such as driver licences, vehicle registrations, boat licences, and various professional and concession cards.

faqs.q: How do I change my address and details for my Opal card?
faqs.a: You can change the address linked to your Opal card using the dedicated Opal card management page.

faqs.q: Do I need to update my details if I move house?
faqs.a: Yes, the guide provides specific links and instructions for updating your details across many NSW government services after moving.
